description: Implementation of a generic linked list template class with methods for adding, removing, and moving nodes, including specialized singly and doubly linked list classes, along with template instantiations for specific types.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: Template class implementing a doubly linked list with methods for node management.

classes.name: HLL
classes.description: Template class for a doubly linked list with memory management features.

classes.name: SLL
classes.description: Template class for a singly linked list.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Template class representing a node in the linked list.

methods.description: Destructor that removes all nodes from the list.

methods.name: linkFront
methods.description: Links a node at the front of the list.

methods.name: linkBack
methods.description: Links a node at the back of the list.

methods.name: removeFront
methods.description: Removes the node at the front.

methods.name: removeBack

methods.name: remove

methods.name: moveBack
